name: LanceDB Open-Source Embedded
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source embedded vector and multimodal database for Python, JavaScript and Rust; local/self-managed storage, vector/full-text search and metadata filtering with no vendor-imposed software query or document quota.
watch_out: This is the self-managed open-source library, not managed LanceDB Cloud. You provide storage, indexing, compute, backups and operations; cloud object storage, embeddings and AI services may cost money. Observe Apache-2.0 notices.
